title: Villa Interior Design 179 m² in Madrid | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 179 m² villa in Madrid: interior design, 3D visualization, technical drawings, custom furniture and turnkey renovation.
h1: Villa interior design project, Madrid, Spain, 179 m²

blocks.text: Villa interior design project, Madrid, Spain, 179 m²

parts.html: For a 179 m² villa in Madrid, the DUMSKAYA DESIGN studio (Bratislava, Slovakia) delivered the full cycle of work: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture manufacturing, and a turnkey renovation. The design covered the living room, bedroom, kitchen with custom interior fittings and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom; furniture designed by the studio was made for each area.

Before the renovation began, the client received a detailed cost estimate for labor, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting. The gallery features 3D visualizations of the villa.
